metronome:
Displays visual metronome
Not usable in conditions
attackStyle:
Attack style
E.g. Accurate, Aggressive, Accurate, Rapid, Wind Surge
attackType:
Damage type
E.g. Stab, Slash, Crush, Ranging, Magic
lvl_: Skill level based on your current XP
boost_: Current skill level with boosts and drains applied
xpRate_: XP/hour in a skill, uses the XP Tracker plugin
xp_: XP in a skill, e.g. {xp_99 - xp_attack}
hasThralls: Can cast thralls: Arceuus, Book of the Dead, and runes
hasAlchs: Can cast High Level Alchemy: Standard spellbook and runes
hasFreeze: Can cast Ice Barrage: Ancient and runes
hasEntangle: Can cast Entangle: Standard and runes
hasItem: Holding an item containing <name> in its name
showItems: Icons of the listed items you hold
showOneItem: Icon of the first listed item you hold
runePouch: Icons of every rune you hold
weekday: Day of the week, Mon - Sun (1-7)
equip_: Item in an equipment slot, or Empty
kc: Kill count, uses the Chat Commands plugin
pb: Personal best, uses the Chat Commands plugin
loot: Loot from a monster, uses the Loot Tracker plugin
log: Collection log data, uses the RuneProfile plugin
slayerTask: Current slayer task, uses the Slayer plugin
tileCol=:
Set tile color
Cannot be used in conditions
highlight:
Set tile corner highlights
Cannot be used in conditions
borderWidth=:
Tile outline width, up to 10
Cannot be used in conditions
align=: Set text alignment, for use across newlines (\n)
party: Calculate variables for different members in your party
readyCheck:
Only usable inside {party {readyCheck}\t{rsn}}
Reads chat messages for ready status
divine: Ticks remaining on a divine potion
worldInfo: World with flag, players and ping
hasVileVigour: Can cast Vile Vigour: Arceuus and runes
hasVengeance: Can cast Vengeance: Lunar and runes
hasUndeadGrasp: Can cast Undead Grasp: Arceuus and runes
hasMarkOfDarkness: Can cast Mark of Darkness: Arceuus and runes
hasSpellbookSwap: Can cast Spellbook Swap: Lunar and runes
hasSurge: Any surge spell castable, or specific {hasSurge air water icon}
hasBarrage: Any barrage spell castable, or specific {hasBarrage blood ice icon}
active: Active effects: Vengeance, Thrall, Death Charge, Shadow Veil, Mark of Darkness
group:
Read the current value set by {setGroup}
E.g. {group == }
setGroup:
Uses this tile as a tile to manually pick value for {group}
E.g. {setGroup , , *}
quickPrayers:
Quick prayer icons or whether quick prayer is set
E.g. {quickPrayers Missiles}
hoverOnly: Set text to show when hovered, uses {hoverOnly}text{/hoverOnly} syntax
hoverHide: Set text to hide when hovered, uses {hoverHide}text{/hoverHide} syntax
tip=: Set a tooltip on text or icons, uses {tip}text{/tip} syntax
ground:
Icons and text drawn flat on the tile
Cannot be used in conditions
